title: Baked Cod with Juicy Welsh Stew
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring baked cod served with a flavorful and moist Welsh stew.
instructions: Season the cod fillets with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and dried thyme.
Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe pan over medium heat.
Sear the cod fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side, then transfer the pan to the preheated oven.
Bake the cod for 8-10 minutes or until cooked through.
In a separate pan, cook the Welsh stew meat over medium heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion and mushrooms to the pan with the stew meat and cook until the vegetables are softened.
Season the stew with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve the baked cod with the Welsh stew on the side.
